text:
mike: Quick ping — opened PR to adjust client proto for header propagation and optional metadata field. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-client/pull/4234 

lina: taking a look in a bit. Does this change affect toolcall headers or only the SDK wrapper?

mike: only the SDK wrapper + low-level proto for requests. Toolcall path unchanged but header normalization moved to a shared helper. Added unit tests for headers normalization.

david: on mobile now but fyi we should add a changelog note and a backwards-compat test for old clients that send x-redwood-meta as a string vs the new map shape.

sam: I'll run the integration suite across older client builds. Are there any migration steps or server-side assumptions we need to be aware of?

mike: no server changes. I added a compatibility flag in the proto (preserve_legacy_headers=true by default). If set false the new map format is enforced. Default keeps old behavior so it should be safe for staged rollouts.

lina: code looks reasonable. one nit: in sdk/transport.go you reserialize headers with json.Marshal which can produce non-deterministic map ordering — please add a comment and a deterministic stringify helper to avoid CI flakes (or sort keys before marshal).

ci-bot: Unit tests passed (92/92). Integration job queued: job/integ-2026-03-15-7.

david: also please add a line in releases/notes.md and bump the client minor version in package.json. Ops will want that for the Dedicated release notes.

mike: done — added README snippet + releases/notes.md entry and bumped minor version, force-pushed. Also added an e2e that simulates the legacy header string case. PTAL.

sam: running the integ suite now, will report back. If green I can approve.

lina: one small style nit in the helper (exported func comment) then LGTM.

sam: integ passed on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, no regressions. Approving. @mike feel free to merge after addressing the style nit and the release note addendum (one-line).

mike: thanks all — addressed both, merging in 10m. :thumbsup:
